description.title: Turn early retirement into a few clear assumptions
description.body: Enter age, spending, pension, return, and inflation assumptions. The calculator simulates each year across work, early retirement, and pension-supported retirement to show how much you need to save now.
description.note: All inputs are calculated locally and are not saved. For questions or feedback, welcome to add WeChat: 807103724

inputForm.ageSettingsIntro: Start with the timeline: your age now, when work income stops, when pension starts, and how long assets should last.
inputForm.currentAgeDesc: The simulation starts from this age. Use a whole number.
inputForm.earlyRetirementDesc: From this age onward, employment income stops and assets cover living expenses.
inputForm.legalRetirementDesc: From this age onward, pension income offsets living expenses.
inputForm.planningEndDesc: Check whether assets can last until this age; use a higher number for a more conservative plan.
inputForm.financialStatusIntro: Enter amounts in today's purchasing power; future expenses, pension, and targets are inflated automatically.
inputForm.monthlyExpensesDesc: Use your current average monthly spending; retirement spending starts from this same baseline.
inputForm.currentSavingsDesc: Include savings and investments available for retirement planning, preferably net of debt.
inputForm.monthlyPensionDesc: Expected monthly income after legal retirement; the model deducts it from that age onward.
inputForm.expectedSavingsDesc: In today's money, how much you want to retain at legal retirement; enter 0 if pension fully covers living costs.
inputForm.investmentParamsIntro: Use long-term nominal annual assumptions; the results also show the return after inflation.
inputForm.annualReturnDesc: Long-term nominal annual return. Prefer a conservative estimate after fees and risk adjustments.
inputForm.inflationRateDesc: Used to convert future expenses, pension, and asset targets into future amounts.

results.title: Calculation Results
results.solvedMessage: The monthly savings below can support the plan through the planning horizon while meeting the legal-retirement asset target.
results.infeasibleMessage: Even at the search cap for working-year savings, the plan still has an estimated shortfall of {{shortfall}}. Consider retiring later, spending less, working longer, or lowering the target.
results.progressText: Early-retirement funding progress from current assets: {{progress}}%
results.requiredSavingsHelp: The asset base needed when early retirement begins.
results.monthlySavingsHelp: Average new savings needed each month until early retirement.
results.requiredSalaryHelp: A simple lower bound: current spending plus the required monthly savings.
results.legalCheckpointHelp: The target is inflated to legal retirement age; projected assets are worth about {{todayValue}} in today's money.
results.planningEndSavingsHelp: Remaining assets at the planning horizon, worth about {{todayValue}} in today's money.
results.realAnnualReturnHelp: The purchasing-power return after removing inflation from nominal investment return.
results.sensitivityDesc: How much more you would need to save each month if assumptions worsen.
results.assumptionNote: This is a year-by-year estimate based on fixed return and inflation assumptions. It is not investment advice and does not guarantee returns or lifespan outcomes.

formula.title: Explanation
formula.lead: In short: it checks whether your money can last if you stop working at a chosen age.
formula.point1: While working: salary covers spending, assets keep growing.
formula.point2: After early retirement: expenses come from assets.
formula.point3: After legal retirement: pension pays first, assets cover the gap.
formula.note: For comparing assumptions, not investment advice.
